label: Photographic
summary: Cinematic editorial stills. The pipeline default.

label: Anime
summary: Cel-shaded anime illustration with clean linework.
download: Put an anime SDXL checkpoint in ComfyUI/models/checkpoints. Animagine XL or Illustrious XL are the usual picks, around 6.5 GB.

label: Illustrated monologue (storybook)
summary: Vintage oil-painted relationship storybook art with aged canvas texture, warm animated-film atmosphere, and visible loving, grieving, or solitary faces. Square 1:1 for blurred-fill framing.
download: Needs an illustration checkpoint. Animagine XL is installed and works.

label: Illustrated monologue (living storybook)
summary: The vintage oil-painted relationship look with expressive faces, plus subtle character breathing, drifting atmosphere, moving light, and a restrained camera push.
download: Needs an illustration checkpoint. Animagine XL is installed and works.

label: Flat vector
summary: Bold geometric shapes and hard edges. Closest to motion-graphics art.
download: Works on any SDXL checkpoint, but needs a vector or flat-design LoRA in ComfyUI/models/loras to look right. Search Civitai for vector art or flat design SDXL LoRAs, usually 100 to 400 MB.

label: Ink line art
summary: Single-weight monoline strokes on dark ground. Matches the drawn-stroke motion style.
download: Tested on RealVisXL and it still returns photographs. Needs an illustration checkpoint (Illustrious XL, Animagine XL, DreamShaper XL) or a lineart LoRA to actually draw.

label: FLUX.2 nostalgic storybook (local first)
summary: Nostalgic hand-drawn romance panels with ink contours, matte retro color, paper grain, expressive people, and automatic cast/style references. Uses local FLUX.2 Klein first and Cloudflare only as a configured fallback.
download: Install the official FLUX.2 Klein 4B BF16 diffusion model, Qwen 3 4B text encoder, and FLUX.2 VAE. BF16 is required on Apple Silicon because MPS cannot execute FP8 weights.

referencePrompts.prompt: A clean wordless cast reference for a nostalgic hand-drawn relationship story. Show two contemporary adults as separate full-body figures with distinct silhouettes: one with shoulder-length dark hair in a simple rust or cream coat, the other with loose shorter dark hair in a deep navy or brown coat. Keep their presentation adaptable so the narration can determine gender and relationship. Natural average proportions, ordinary timeless clothing, quiet expressive posture, relaxed hands, three-quarter and side views, minimal softly drawn facial features, bold dark ink contours, loose pencil hatching, matte flat colors, subtle paper grain, plain warm-cream background. No scene, no props, no lettering, no labels, no symbols, no border.

A representative wordless frame from a nostalgic hand-drawn romance animation: two small contemporary adults seen from behind at the edge of a quiet sea beneath an enormous deep-teal evening sky, burnt-orange grass in the foreground, simple dark horizon, bold ink contours, loose pencil hatching, matte flat color blocks, restrained cel shading, visible paper tooth, subtle halftone and aged film speckles, slightly imperfect screen-printed finish, warm melancholy, large poetic negative space. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no border.

download: No model download. Set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN in .env.
